logical_identities.name: Age cohort
logical_identities.description: An age band of guests. The complete population distinguishes guests under 35 from guests 35 and older.

logical_identities.name: Beverage platform
logical_identities.description: A beverage platform. The complete population is brewed coffee, espresso, cold, refresher, energy, and protein.

logical_identities.name: Calendar day
logical_identities.description: One calendar date on the Starbucks fiscal calendar. The complete population is the calendar-day dimension.

logical_identities.name: Closure
logical_identities.description: One coffeehouse closure. The complete population is starbucks.capital_store.dim_closure.

logical_identities.name: Coffeehouse
logical_identities.description: One Starbucks coffeehouse, including pipeline, open, identified-to-close, and closed locations. The complete population is starbucks.store.dim_coffeehouse.

logical_identities.name: Coffeehouse labor-model assignment
logical_identities.description: One coffeehouse assigned to one Green Apron wave. The complete population is starbucks.labor.fact_green_apron_cohort_assignment. Weekly outcomes are partial.

logical_identities.name: Coffeehouse operating week
logical_identities.description: One coffeehouse in one operating week. Operating results, Green Apron weekly outcomes, service, daypart hours, and partner feedback reconcile on this key. No dataset in this slice is the complete population of coffeehouse-weeks.

logical_identities.name: Commodity
logical_identities.description: One purchased commodity, including coffee. The complete population is the commodity dimension.

logical_identities.name: Competitor format
logical_identities.description: A competitive format in the coffee and away-from-home beverage market, such as a coffee specialist, a drive-thru and takeout format, a non-specialist advertiser, or an energy-drink occasion.

logical_identities.name: Cost element
logical_identities.description: One P&L cost element. The complete population separates coffee, other product cost, distribution, store labor, marketing, occupancy, and general and administrative.

logical_identities.name: Country
logical_identities.description: One country used for Starbucks coffeehouse operations. The complete population is starbucks.organization.dim_country.

logical_identities.name: Currency
logical_identities.description: One currency in which Starbucks records amounts and exchange rates. The complete population is the currency dimension.

logical_identities.name: Daypart
logical_identities.description: A serving daypart. The complete population is the morning and afternoon rows of the daypart dimension.

logical_identities.name: Daypart schedule
logical_identities.description: One operating daypart, including morning, afternoon, evening, and overnight. The complete population is starbucks.labor.dim_daypart_schedule.

logical_identities.name: Fiscal period
logical_identities.description: One Starbucks fiscal period. The fiscal year ends on the Sunday closest to September 30, quarters are 13 weeks except a 14-week fourth quarter in a 53-week year, and periods follow a 4-4-5 week pattern. The half and the quarter are attributes of the period. Labels use the Starbucks fiscal-period form, such as FY2026-P03.

logical_identities.name: GL account
logical_identities.description: One general-ledger account. The complete population is the GL-account dimension.

logical_identities.name: Guidance scenario
logical_identities.description: One earnings guidance scenario, including the high end and the low end of a Starbucks fiscal-year range. The complete population is the guidance-scenario dimension.

logical_identities.name: Journal line
logical_identities.description: One posted general-ledger journal line. The complete population is the journal-line fact.

logical_identities.name: Labor model cohort
logical_identities.description: One Green Apron rollout wave. Wave, install date, and weeks since install are carried by the cohort dimension, the assignment fact, and the weekly outcome fact. The complete population of waves is starbucks.labor.dim_labor_model_cohort.

logical_identities.name: Legal entity
logical_identities.description: One Starbucks legal entity that can hold journal postings. The complete population is the legal-entity dimension.

logical_identities.name: Licensee
logical_identities.description: One licensee that operates licensed Starbucks coffeehouses. The complete population is starbucks.organization.dim_licensee.

logical_identities.name: Margin bridge line
logical_identities.description: One line of the North America company-operated operating-margin bridge. The complete population is the margin-bridge fact.

logical_identities.name: Marketing campaign
logical_identities.description: A Starbucks marketing campaign or sustained advertising effort, including brand initiatives, broad acquisition, menu innovation, and the digital menu board test.

logical_identities.name: Marketing spend
logical_identities.description: One marketing-spend record with dollars, percent of sales, and a media channel. The complete population is the marketing-spend fact.

logical_identities.name: Menu item
logical_identities.description: A sellable menu item, including items removed since the turnaround started.

logical_identities.name: Operating week
logical_identities.description: One Starbucks operating week. The complete population is starbucks.labor.dim_operating_week.

logical_identities.name: Order channel
logical_identities.description: How the guest placed and received the order. The complete population is cafe, drive-thru, delivery, and mobile order.

logical_identities.name: Ownership type
logical_identities.description: One coffeehouse ownership type. The codes are company_operated and licensed. The complete population is starbucks.store.dim_ownership_type.

logical_identities.name: Partner
logical_identities.description: One Starbucks store partner. The complete population is starbucks.labor.dim_partner.

logical_identities.name: Remodel
logical_identities.description: One coffeehouse remodel project. The complete population is starbucks.capital_store.dim_remodel.

logical_identities.name: Rewards member
logical_identities.description: A Starbucks Rewards member. A non-Rewards guest is not a member.

logical_identities.name: Service interval
logical_identities.description: One service-measurement interval and its ticket-time target, including the four-minute promise. The complete population is starbucks.labor.dim_service_interval.

logical_identities.name: Tariff
logical_identities.description: One tariff program. Refunds against a tariff are their own fact. The complete population is the tariff dimension.

logical_identities.name: Transaction
logical_identities.description: One settled Starbucks guest check. The check is a different population from its menu lines and from a comparable-sales bridge component.

logical_identities.name: Transaction line
logical_identities.description: One menu item line on a Starbucks guest check.
